items.title: European equities flatline as markets digest Nvidia board probe
items.summary: Investing.com - European shares began the week on a dour note, as a heavy slate of upcoming macroeconomic data and unsettling leadership drama at artificial intelligence bellwether Nvidia kept markets on the sidelines.

items.summary: Zacks' Earnings Preview highlights AMAT, CSCO, BRK.B, NVDA, MU and GOOGL as key companies amid broad-based Q3 earnings growth and evolving estimate revisions.

items.title: Cinemark and Whirlpool have been highlighted as Zacks Bull and Bear of the Day
items.summary: CNK's record results and rising earnings estimates earn it Bull of the Day, while WHR's weak demand and sharply reduced earnings outlook make it a Bear.
